name: Peret
role: lay-brother of the Choir; the knife-man
backstory: A lay-brother of the Pyrehouse's inner circle, Peret cut Isine at the pyre and gave the Choir's wafers to the Ashward's dying. Chadickith knocked him out in the almshouse dead-house and handed him to Halda, who released him to Coldwell at the dusk bell on day 2.
secrets: He carried a list of six Ashward names, two marked done.
